releaseNotes: Cloud & Online now has a Cloud status check you can run yourself: it proves the server is reachable, the school and backup tables answer, your key is accepted, and the teacher link function is present. Also lets you point the console at a different Supabase project simply by pasting its URL and anon key. Full teacher control, one-code QR join and A4 fee-free reports from the previous builds are all included.
